```ts
import { getAnimationGroups, stopAnimation } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import type { AnimationManager } from "@babylonjs/lite";

function resolveToParent(obj: object, path: string): object | undefined {
    const segments = path.split(".");
    // All segments except the last
    const parentPath = segments.slice(0, -1);
    let current: any = obj;
    for (const seg of parentPath) {
        if (current == null) return undefined;
        current = current[seg];
    }
    return current;
}

export function releaseProperty(manager: AnimationManager, target: object, path: string): void {
    const segments = path.split(".");
    const lastSegment = segments[segments.length - 1];
    const parentPath = segments.slice(0, -1);
    
    // Resolve the object that owns the last segment
    let parentObj: any = target;
    for (const seg of parentPath) {
        if (parentObj == null) return;
        parentObj = parentObj[seg];
    }
    if (parentObj == null) return;
    
    const groups = getAnimationGroups(manager);
    for (const group of groups) {
        const targeted = group.targetedAnimations;
        for (const ta of targeted) {
            if (ta.target === parentObj && ta.path === lastSegment) {
                stopAnimation(group);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}
```
